defects: The Epi hypothesis is placed on the wrong morphism: fy₁₀₁ : v₁₀₁ ⟶ v₁₁₁ lies entirely within the target (x=1) face itself (both endpoints already have x=1), whereas gold's epi hypothesis (Epi f00x) is on an edge that goes from a vertex outside the target face (M000, z=0) into a vertex of the target face (M001, z=1) — i.e. one of the edges connecting the parallel opposite face into the missing face's face. The produced statement instead needs the epi to be on one of fx₀₀₀, fx₀₀₁, fx₀₁₀, or fx₀₁₁ (the x-direction edges from the x=0 face into the x=1 face) to be a valid instance of the cube lemma.

As a direct consequence, the produced theorem is mathematically FALSE, not merely differently-shaped: a concrete counterexample exists in the category Set (v000=v001=v010=v011={*}, v100=v110={1,2}, v101={x,y,z}, v111={a,b}, with explicit maps) where all five hypotheses h1–h5 hold and fy₁₀₁ is epi (surjective), yet the concluded x=1-face square fails to commute. Hence the produced statement is unprovable, unlike the gold statement which is a genuine theorem.
